provenance_summary: V1-B first expansion wave. Magnetic adsorbents (Fe₃O₄-based) functionalized with polydopamine (PDA), β-cyclodextrin (β-CD), and graphene oxide (GO) for recyclable dye and heavy metal removal. Magnetic separation enables easy recovery and reuse.

mechanisms.description: Electrostatic interaction: cationic dyes adsorbed via electrostatic attraction to negatively charged surface (pHpzc = 4.32); at pH > 4.32, deprotonated -COOH groups create negative surface charge

pollutant_feature.text: Cationic dyes (MB, MG, CV) with positive charge

interaction.text: Electrostatic attraction between cationic dyes and negatively charged adsorbent surface

why_it_works.text: Favorable at pH > 4.32; MB adsorption optimal at pH 11

causal_chain.verification_quote: The saturation magnetization is about 23.81 emu/g. As a consequence, owing to superior magnetic properties, the PDA/MGO/CA-CD can be easily separated from the solution by using a magnet. After reaching the adsorption equilibrium, the PDA/MGO/CA-CD adsorbent could be rapidly separated from solution within 30 s under an external magnetic field.

engineering_constraints.description: Dopamine self-polymerization: 500 mg MGO + 500 mg DA in Tris buffer (pH 8.5), stirred 24h at room temperature
CA-CD polymer preparation: 1.5 g CA + 1.5 g β-CD + 0.5 g KH₂PO₄ in 60 mL H₂O, heated at 145°C for 3.5h (69.43% yield)
BET surface area: PDA/MGO/CA-CD has low SSA (6.74 m²/g) vs MGO (256.45 m²/g); adsorption is chemically driven, not physical

design_translation.idea: Combine magnetic Fe₃O₄ nanoparticles with graphene oxide, functionalize with polydopamine and β-cyclodextrin polymer to create a magnetically recyclable adsorbent for cationic dyes
examples: PDA/MGO/CA-CD for MB (1372 mg/g), MG (822 mg/g), CV (571 mg/g)
Magnetic separation within 30s using permanent magnet
design_translation.applicability: Cationic dye removal from textile wastewater; selective capture from mixed dye solutions

knowledge_gaps: Long-term stability beyond 8 cycles not tested
Performance with real industrial wastewater (complex matrix) needs more data

narrative.text: Magnetic adsorbents combine the advantages of high adsorption capacity (from functional groups) with easy recovery (from magnetic Fe₃O₄ nanoparticles). Mussel-inspired polydopamine coating provides abundant -OH and -NH₂ groups for further functionalization, while β-cyclodextrin adds host-guest capture capability for organic pollutants.
